name: cable shoulder 90 degrees external rotation
description: Rotate your forearm up and back against a cable with your upper arm at shoulder height. It strengthens the rotator cuff external rotators.
instructions: Set a cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and back without moving your upper arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
